Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: W02
Accountable role (person unassigned): Frontend/integration engineer with curator
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: A project shows its datasets, responsibilities and outstanding review work in one coherent workflow.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Provide project overview, authorized dataset search and bounded inventory/history navigation, assignment/status/notes for curation tasks, and an activity trail.
2. Bind findings, reports and human review outcomes to exact releases; distinguish acceptance, automated checks and reviewed quality; new releases do not silently inherit approval.
3. Keep task/attachment/search visibility within underlying dataset authority; curator and researcher complete daily work without operator CLI or internal UUID entry.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.
